title: db-studio
description: Launch Drizzle Studio against the host database.

config.description: Path to the host's ortha.config.ts (relative to the workspace root).

host.description: Host interface Studio's local server binds to (drizzle-kit default: 127.0.0.1). Studio has NO authentication and full read/write access to the database, so anything other than loopback offers a database console to the network — a warning is printed when you do.

port.description: Port Studio's local server listens on (drizzle-kit default: 4983). 0 is refused: drizzle-kit binds an ephemeral port but prints the one it was asked for.
